Helltaker is a short but a really cute, funny and good puzzle, adventure game. Okay it’s time for a story. It’s just you and your desire to make a demon girl harem, enough said.

The likes, the gameplay is simple but fun and challenging especially when you get to the boss level. The art style is very adorable whenever you're playing the game or watching the cutscenes. The puzzles in the game are hard but fair it's a lot of trial and error, but it won’t take you to long to beat it. The music in the game is really good has a nice techno feel to it. 
The story is really good it has a lot of adorable and funny moments, the characters in the game are really good, they have great designs and have great personalities and they also look sexy. 

My personal favorite of the characters is Pandemonica, her design is very adorable, I love her hair it looks so fluffy and I love her personality. I just want to cuddle and take care of her. Another thing is the game is free which is cool, but I recommend buying the DLC I know the DLC is expensive for a short game, but it has so much in it, from character designs, to cute Comics as well as a recipes. 

The multiple endings you can get were good, as well as trying to romance the demons and reading the fails you can get. Also be anniversary update for the game is really good it adds a new story, new kinds of puzzles and a new Final Boss to fight as well.

The dislikes, there is pretty much nothing to dislike about the game I will say it is a bit on the short side but honestly I don't really mind that. Okay with that said Helltaker is a short but a really cute, funny and good puzzle, adventure game. There is so much to love about this game, from its really good story, to its really good characters and a simple but fun and challenging gameplay, so I highly recommend getting this game I also recommend getting the DLC and supporting the Creator.

I'm not a fan of puzzle games to begin with aside from bubble dinos (Name eludes me) and the frequent adult game, so after seeing all the twitter art I had to get my hands on this. With a simple art style I was glad it was free, because what I got was a game a short game that had me working my brain to finish each level.

Gameplay:
You can play this game with one hand. Not implying anything there, but you can use WASD or arrow keys to move around and do your business. What surprised me was that it had controller support (kept both hands on the controller)

Sound:
The sound effects in the game are whacky as a cartoon and it fit with the art style perfectly. Aside from the whack beatdowns and shuffling  the actual soundtrack is a banger for only 5 songs. I recommend buying the soundtrack separately from the game (free or 10 dollars)

Story:
You're a dude looking to get a harem of demon girls. Don't think so hard on it.

Value:
For a free game I put enough time to justify buying the bonus content. If you want a free experience you can get a good hour wasted in a flash and a lot of heart went into this product. I would have overlooked this game if it wasn't FREE.

Final Thoughts:
I forked the money to buy the digital art book and pancake recipe. I didn't feel cheated by doing this and I feel the money will not be going to waste if more products like this come out in the future. A lot of heart was put into this product and if it wasn't free I wouldn't have a crepe recipe (and a lot of twitter art saved). 10/10
